description: Details pursuant to the discharge of Conditions 10 (Low Emissions Strategy), 14 (Delivery and Servicing Plan) and 23 (Energy Demand and Carbon Emissions Post-Construction) in relation to planning permission ref. 46378/APP/2019/2970 approved 07-10-2021 (Development of land north of playing pitches to provide an extension to West London Film Studios comprising construction of new sound stages, workshops and office accommodation, entrance structures and reception and security offices (Use Class Sui Generis), creation of new vehicular and pedestrian accesses from Springfield Road, with associated car parking, landscaping and the provision of an ecological enhancement area/landscaped buffer zone).
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
